South Loop Lofts - 3BR 2BA $3,295/mo (price reduced from $3,395). 1400 S Michigan Ave, Chicago IL 60605. Move-in costs: security deposit $1,500 plus last month's rent, and a $300 non-refundable cat fee. Garage: call for pricing. Parking pass $85/mo. Heat and water included; typical bills for the unit about $120 a month. Pet screening fee $25 per pet. Dishwasher, laundry in building. Available January 15, 2027.
